about: A guide writer and an editor prepare a study guide for new students. Each agent may write up to 4000 tokens in one reply. Both run on Anthropic Fast.
how: A chain of two agents with a high limit on the length of one reply.
learns: With a high limit the agent finishes its text: about 2,300 output tokens in all, and nothing is cut.
watch: The two answers end with a complete sentence and the run has no warning. Compare with the twin that has a limit of 1000.
